senses.zh_definition: 〔日语工艺术语〕技艺精湛的工匠；匠师。
senses.en_definition: In Japanese craftsmanship terminology, a highly skilled artisan or master craftsperson.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam konteks pertukangan Jepun, seorang tukang yang mempunyai kemahiran sangat tinggi dalam bidangnya.
senses.nuances: 本义项仅适用于日语匠师概念的介绍，不能据此认定为已获DBP确认的马来语普通名词。马来语可按语境解释为 tukang mahir 或 pakar pertukangan。马来文释义为编辑释义，并非DBP原文。词义依据：[Mazda Dictionary](https://mazdastories.com/en_us/inspire/mazda-dictionary/)。

dual_scenarios.context: 职场汇报 / 日本制造工艺介绍
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam pembentangan ini, istilah takumi merujuk kepada tukang Jepun yang sangat mahir dalam bidangnya.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在本次汇报中，takumi 一词指在其专业领域技艺精湛的日本工匠。
dual_scenarios.en: In this presentation, the term takumi refers to a Japanese craftsperson with exceptional expertise.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 讨论日本工艺纪录片
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku baru tengok video pasal takumi ni, teliti betul kerja dia!
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya baru menonton video tentang seorang takumi ini; hasil kerjanya sangat teliti.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我刚看了这个匠师的视频，他做事也太细致了！
dual_scenarios.en: I just watched a video about this takumi. He's incredibly meticulous!

messages.zh: 你看过那个介绍匠师的视频了吗？
messages.en: Have you watched that video about takumi yet?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah. Aku nak tengok lagi, teliti betul kerja dia.

messages.en: Yeah. I want to watch it again. He's so meticulous.

etymology.historical_story: Takumi belongs to Japanese craftsmanship vocabulary. Mazda uses it for highly skilled craftspeople who develop specialist expertise and pass their techniques to apprentices. Lexus Malaysia also presents takumi craftsmanship to its audience. These sources establish a Japanese cultural and industrial context; they do not establish official adoption into standard Malay. [Mazda Dictionary](https://mazdastories.com/en_us/inspire/mazda-dictionary/), [Lexus Malaysia](https://www.lexus.com.my/en/discover-lexus/lexus-creates/lexus-experience.html).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 联想记忆：ta-ku-mi →「他，苦练，迷于工艺」→ 技艺精湛的匠师。这是记忆联想，不是词源拆解。
